acceptanceCriteria: The stable public v0.2.23 Release, tag target e3ae6ab59aca0a281f1e341da8972fe02ab2b007, release workflow 32629400996, archive SHA256 4330f415b8e83d4dcfb57ad3b3e6b0ff7583039a762289ee41dcb2c697632d33, and release-manifest.json are retained as immutable external facts.

The installed Runtime is the downloaded public v0.2.23 aarch64-apple-darwin binary and its SHA256 is bound in repository-local evidence; no cargo build, cargo run, workspace binary, or local target fallback is used.

A fresh isolated adopter run with the public binary retains runtime identity, repositoryId, attach/profile/inspect/status/doctor/agent-doctor/verify JSON, evidence reuse, first-adopter-smoke not_ready, and the complete Work Item lifecycle.

The adopter isolation proof covers HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, TMPDIR, CARGO_HOME, repository state, files, directories, symlinks, and digests before/after; all temporary roots are removed on success and failure without changing acceptance truth.

The current repository tri-language parity documents and Work Item reader pages record WI-183, WI-184, WI-185, and this WI-186 with equivalent release/runtime/evidence facts; no historical evidence or Release truth is rewritten.

Documentation, parity, release-version, and repository self-check gates pass with the installed public v0.2.23 Runtime, and the repository closes with no active Work Item or stale merged Work Item branch.

The visible human Outcome is rendered in Chinese with a non-folded Outcome marker and explicit unknowns, evidence, decision, and next action; green does not claim external release authorization beyond the recorded evidence.
goal: Establish a reproducible repository-local post-release acceptance baseline for the immutable public v0.2.23 binary, including adopter isolation, evidence identity, tri-language parity, and branch/worktree closure.
intent: Use the released Runtime as the only implementation interface for the next development cycle and detect publication, installation, isolation, evidence, documentation, or cleanup regressions before further feature work.
outOfScope: public Release assets, tags, and existing historical evidence bytes
